name: jnmetacode/superpowers-zh
description: Chinese community edition of a software development workflow skill set. It provides structured brainstorming and planning, test-driven development and debugging workflows, and related engineering practices, with 15 translated skills plus 4 China-original skills. The sample skill read covers brainstorming in Chinese.
install: npx superpowers-zh (per-tool variants documented in the README install table), plus manual copy to each tool's skills directory.
